title: Dental New Patient Checklist
subtitle: Capture dental concern, prior records, imaging reference, and care-team review; confirm consent status and follow-up.
description: Dental New Patient records dental concern, prior records, imaging reference, care-team review, consent status, and follow-up. Dental New Patient evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this dental new patient stage-gated verification when staff must document dental concern and prior records. Reconcile imaging reference, care-team review, consent status, and follow-up before the dental new patient handoff. Use the patient-stated concern, prior-dentist contact, records request, radiograph availability, appliance list, care-team intake review, appointment plan, and follow-up note. This intake centers oral-health concerns, tooth or gum location, prior dental office, radiograph transfer, appliance history, hygiene context, operatory access, and dental-team follow-up. Ask the assigned dental new patient reviewer to confirm dental concern against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Dental New Patient contact and reference
sections.guidance: Capture dental concern in patient words, prior dentist and records, imaging availability, appliance or accessibility need, care-team review, and follow-up. Keep any urgent dental new patient issue with its escalation contact and time.

items: Dental concern is identified for this record
